# Lesser Restoration (`spells:lesser-restoration`)
**Level 2 [Abjuration](../magic-schools/abjuration.md)** | **Casting Time:** Bonus Action | **Range:** Touch
**Components:** V, S | **Duration:** Instantaneous | **Classes:** [Bard](../classes/bard.md), [Cleric](../classes/cleric.md), [Druid](../classes/druid.md), [Paladin](../classes/paladin.md), [Ranger](../classes/ranger.md)

You touch a creature and end one condition on it: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.
